name: browser
description: Drive a headless Chromium browser via Playwright. Render JS-heavy pages, take screenshots, and interact with elements. State persists across calls in a session.

action.description: One of: goto, text, html, title, screenshot, click, type, wait, eval, cookies, cookies_export, close.

url.description: URL to navigate to (used with goto, text, html, title, screenshot).

selector.description: CSS selector for an element (used with click, type, wait).

text.description: Text to type into an element (used with type).

expression.description: JavaScript expression to run on the page (used with eval).

output.description: File path for the screenshot (used with screenshot, default screenshot.png).

wait_ms.description: Milliseconds to wait after navigation for JS to settle (default 1500).

max_chars.description: Max characters to return for text/html/eval (default 8000).

cookie_file.description: Path to a JSON file of cookies to import (used with action=cookies). Format: array of {name, value, domain, path, expires, httpOnly, secure, sameSite}.
